verdicts.reason: The two use the same flawed layout. The 'WEEKEND ONLY' eyebrow has moved below the headline, and the 'Ends Sunday' fine print now sits above the product, competing with the subhead instead of being subordinate. '20% off' runs into the purple circle, and the top ~80px are dead space. A keeps a comfortable ~22px left margin. B pushes the text to ~12px from the left edge with a larger headline that cuts further into the circle, so it looks more cramped.
